name: Umpi
summary: In Tarren Mill, Umpi suffers through Apothecary Lydon's experiments. The frog is kept in the Royal Apothecary Society's workshop for tests of toxins and plague brews.

sections.title: A Life of Perpetual Testing
sections.body: In Tarren Mill, Umpi is a frog who bears the cost of Apothecary Lydon's experiments. He tests his formulas on living flesh, giving Umpi lethal brews such as the Elixir of Suffering and the Elixir of Agony. The poisons kill her. Then Lydon re-animates her for another dose in service of the Royal Apothecary Society.

faq.answer: Umpi is a frog kept by Apothecary Lydon in Tarren Mill. Lydon uses her as an assistant and the chief subject of his alchemical experiments.

faq.q: Why does Apothecary Lydon keep killing Umpi?
faq.answer: Apothecary Lydon uses Umpi to measure the strength of his newly brewed toxins. He gives her fatal brews such as the Elixir of Suffering, then re-animates her for another trial.
Umpi is raised from the dead after each fatal poisoning. Apothecary Lydon says he re-animates her, though she functions as a beast.
Umpi is inside the apothecary workshop in Tarren Mill, in the Hillsbrad Foothills. She is beside Apothecary Lydon's workbench.

angles.text: As an Undead, you see the Royal Apothecary Society's ruthless methods firsthand. Its researchers treat life and death as variables as they perfect the Forsaken arsenal.
